_README: Fill base_input_per_mtok and base_output_per_mtok with YOUR real, current prices ($ per 1,000,000 tokens) for each model. The benchmark applies the official cache multipliers (fresh 1x, cache-write-5m 1.25x, cache-write-1h 2x, cache-read 0.1x) itself — do NOT bake those in here. While a value is null the cost view stays blank for that model (no fabricated number). The benchmark measures the WORKER turn, so the worker model's prices are the ones that matter.
